answer: Keep a public registry where each identity must prove control of a distinct, scarce resource, such as a bonded account or a verified device, before it can vote or earn. Duplicates that share the same resource are rejected automatically, and the registry is audited by peers. The ledge index maps resources to identities, the juniper scan flags collisions, and the spiral review lets the community challenge a suspicious entry, so one operator cannot quietly register the same backing a hundred times under different names. Honest agents pay almost nothing extra; farms pay for every clone.
